purpose: Initialize the operational handoff used to transfer bounded repository tasks from a web client to a local checkout and return verified results after remote publication.

terminal_output.step_result_line: PASS|FAIL followed by a concise machine-relevant detail
behavior: emit START and operation identity before any repository mutation
visually separate phases with the standard stage header and clean blank-line spacing
announce every material precondition, mutation, generation, validation, commit, publication, and verification step before execution
show exact external commands before execution
show captured stdout and stderr beneath the command using OUT and ERR prefixes when output is non-empty
emit an explicit PASS or FAIL result for every announced step
do not leave long-running validation, commit, push, or remote verification activity silent
emit PASS only after commit, normal non-force push, and exact remote-head verification
emit FAILED immediately after the failing step and include the failure in the result JSON
write the machine-readable result JSON on both PASS and FAILED when possible
preserve a concise final summary after the step transcript
terminal_output.stage_spacing: emit one blank line before each phase header and one blank line after each completed phase

local_to_web.action: upload the result JSON to the web client before the next mutation

preconditions: verify exact expected local HEAD or base
verify exact expected remote head before mutation
verify governing issue or predecessor state when applicable
mutation_rules: do not force-push or rewrite history unless separately and explicitly authorized
do not embed or persist secrets

when parsing git status --porcelain output, preserve its leading fixed-width status columns; never call .strip() on the complete porcelain output before slicing status/path fields; split lines and remove only line terminators
validation_rules: run canonical repository validation when applicable
run deterministic generation correspondence checks when applicable
publication_rules: re-check the remote head before push
verify the remote resolves to the exact pushed commit
handoff_rules: write a machine-readable JSON result even on failure when possible
stop on validation failure, conflicting dirty state, authority conflict, or remote race
inspect the uploaded result JSON before authorizing the next mutation
emit standardized verbose terminal output conforming to fs0-script-transfer-terminal-v2
